_thirdParties: EVERY external host the shipped page can reach. An origin with no entry FAILS — that is the point: an undeclared third party is an undecided one. `basis` is why it is allowed, in your own words. Set personalData:true when the request itself hands that party user data (an IP address counts), and then `consent` must say how that is lawful.

thirdParties.consent: the user signs in to use it; covered by the privacy policy
